name: agentmail
description: Give your agent an inbox: read, send and reply to messages

auth.instruction_md: Create an API key in your own AgentMail console and paste it here. Existing skill credentials are not copied automatically.

io.github.personaljarvis.post_install_hint_md: Uses the official AgentMail MCP server with your API key. Select or create an inbox after connecting; sending uses that inbox, not your personal email account.
